caption: The drawing depicts a wooden object placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The object is a box-like structure with a rectangular base and a vertical back panel that rises above the top surface, curving upward in a semicircular shape with inward curves on either side. The entire object appears to be made of wood, colored in shades of brown with visible grain patterns. The front of the main rectangular box has two sections; the bottom section features a pull-out drawer with two circular handles and decorative horizontal lines, while the upper section displays a flat, closed surface with a central circular motif. The curved back panel is decorated with multiple small circular patterns and has a hole at its center. The perspective shows a slight angle, offering a view of both the front and left side of the box. No other objects or elements are depicted in the drawing.
title: Spice Box
